messages:
lachel: Heads-up: Defender flagged an unsigned binary in our windows-builder image (windows-build-2024-11). It's showing unexpected outbound connections. Marking as a security advisory.

marc: Do we know scope? Is prod affected?

lachel: Early triage: only CI self-hosted Windows runners. No prod workloads on these images. Still treating as a high-severity supply-chain concern.

ops-bot: Created incident INC-2026-042 and scheduled artifact re-scan.

build-team: Actionable next steps?

lachel: Short list: 1) Quarantine image in registry and stop assigning it to runners. 2) Re-bake a clean image from our locked sources and publish windows-build-2026-01. 3) Run artifact scanner for builds from last 30 days. 4) Rotate any CI runner host credentials if the runner executed networked jobs.

sec-automation: Scan command: ./tools/artifact-scanner --image windows-build-2024-11 --since 30d --output reports/win-image-scan.csv

marc: I'll pause merges that trigger self-hosted Windows runners and ping repo owners.

build-team: ETA to bake new image?

ops-bot: Baking started. ETA ~90m. Will publish AMI/VM IDs once available.

lachel: If your repo used that image, do not merge until you get confirmation. Also run local checks: signtool verify /pa <binary> and hashes against allowlist.

sec-automation: We've queued an automated check to ensure only signed vendor binaries are present during image build from now on. Pre-publish will fail on unsigned binary detections.

marc: What if we find a compromised artifact from a build that used the image?

lachel: Containment: revoke CI tokens used by the runner timeframe, rotate service account keys for the runner host, re-run affected CI on the new image, and notify impacted repos. We'll provide a playbook in the incident doc.

build-team: Noted. We'll add a CI gate to detect unsigned binaries and block images that don't match hashed allowlist.

ops-bot: Runner fleet update: replaced windows-build-2024-11 with windows-build-2026-01 (image id: windows-build-2026-01-ami-0f12cd34). Please requeue jobs.

lachel: Office hours in #eng-security at 15:00 PT to walk through migration steps. If you see unexpected network egress from CI artifacts, ping @lachel and @build-team immediately. :shield:
